name: Iraqi voice listening pack 2026-10 (the producer's controlled comparison; docs/VOICE-ENGINE.md §7)
note: LAB TEST — NOT PRODUCTION / NO SPEAKER PERMISSION: the reference is the upstream Habibi IRQ demo clip. The lines are the producer's, as written, never rewritten for an engine. `tagged` is used ONLY by the fish-tagged arm; Habibi and MOSS never receive tags. Fish tags are from the S2 Pro model card's common-tag list (fishaudio/s2-pro@1de9996 README); the warm line has no listed tag, so it uses the card's documented free-form form and is marked tagSource FREE_FORM. Lines with no emotion asked for carry no tag in either Fish arm. One result per engine per line, one fixed seed, no retries.
